Tap Code Translator

Encode text into tap code (prison knock code) dots and decode tap sequences back to letters.

Row-taps then column-taps. Letters separated by /, words by //. K is tapped as C.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter text or a tap-code sequence.
  2. Choose Encode or Decode.
  3. Press Run.
  4. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does tap code work?

Tap code uses a 5×5 grid like Polybius: each letter is row-taps then column-taps, e.g. A is • •, C is ••• •.

What about the letter K?

The grid has no K — K is written as C, so decoding C shows C/K.

How are letters separated?

Letters are separated by / and words by // in the encoded output.
